did_key.description: did:key identifier from an Ed25519 public key.

migration_commit.description: Final cutover commit for the v0.1 to v0.2 live-pair migration. After commit, v0.1 sends stop and rollback requires a corrective v0.2 release.

migration_id.description: Lowercase canonical UUIDv4 identifying the migration run.

relationship_id.description: Lowercase canonical UUIDv4 of the migrated relationship.

migration_ready.description: Mutually signed readiness for the v0.1 to v0.2 cutover. After both sides exchange it, only v0.2 writes are allowed.

migration_id.description: Lowercase canonical UUIDv4 identifying the migration run.

relationship_id.description: Lowercase canonical UUIDv4 of the migrated relationship.

relationship_ready.description: Pairing completion signal exchanged over the relay after commit.

relationship_id.description: Lowercase canonical UUIDv4 of the committed relationship.

description: Sealed v0.2 event envelope. Every listed field is required; nullable fields are present with JSON null. Unknown top-level or protected fields fail validation. Whole sealed envelope, UTF-8 encoded, is at most 262144 bytes (enforced by the validator function, not by this schema). The signature covers the restricted-JCS bytes of the envelope with signature omitted.

ciphertext.description: Base64url (no padding) AES-256-GCM output: the canonicalized typed payload encrypted with the content key, AAD = SHA-256(restricted-JCS(protected)).

content_nonce.description: Base64url (no padding) 12-byte AES-GCM nonce for the payload encryption.

protected.description: Signed, plaintext header. Canonicalized with restricted JCS for the envelope signature and for H = SHA-256(restricted-JCS(protected)).

deliver_at.description: Requested release time for scheduled delivery, or null.

ephemeral_key.description: Per-message ephemeral X25519 public key, multibase base58btc.

event_type.description: Typed event discriminator. Unknown values fail closed.

expires_at.description: Requested suppression time, or null. Suppression only; not remote deletion.

key_epoch.description: Relationship key epoch used for the recipient wraps.

protocol.description: Protocol identifier. Future versions must change this value.

replay_nonce.description: Base64url (no padding) 16 random bytes. Uniqueness enforced per relationship.

reply_to.description: Accepted event this event replies to, in the same conversation and thread, or null.

sender_seq.description: Per-sender sequence: uint64, starts at 1 per (relationship_id, sender), assigned inside the persisting transaction. Capped by the canonicalization safe-integer range.

thread_id.description: Thread scope. Equals the first message's event_id for a new thread; null when the event carries no thread.

recipients.description: Per-recipient key wraps, sorted by recipient then agreement_key. At most two wraps: the dual-wrap bound. A sender wraps the CEK to at most the recipient's current and immediately-previous agreement epochs during a rotation; at all other times there is exactly one wrap. Receivers try at most those two epochs when unsealing.

agreement_key.description: Recipient relationship agreement public key this wrap targets.

wrap_nonce.description: Base64url (no padding) 12-byte AES-GCM nonce for the key wrap.

wrapped_key.description: Base64url (no padding) AES-GCM output: CEK wrapped with KEK, AAD = H || recipient || agreement_key.

signature.description: Base64url (no padding) 64-byte Ed25519 signature over the restricted-JCS bytes of the envelope with signature omitted.

title: Sealed event envelope
